company.name: UltraTech Cement
company.summary: Grey cement, white cement, ready-mix concrete and building solutions used in construction.
company.description: UltraTech Cement manufactures and sells cement and related building materials. Its portfolio includes grey cement, Birla White, ready-mix concrete and specialised construction products.
company.money: Revenue depends on sales volume and prices across regions and products. Fuel, power, freight, raw materials, capacity use and new plants strongly influence profitability and cash needs.
company.ownership: UltraTech Cement Limited is the listed cement company covered here and is part of the Aditya Birla Group. Other group businesses are not automatically part of UltraTech.
watch: Are plants selling more without leaving too much capacity idle?
How do selling prices compare with energy, freight and material costs?
Are new plants earning adequate returns after construction spending?
risks: Construction and infrastructure activity can change by region.
Cement is energy-intensive and costly to transport.
Too much industry capacity can weaken pricing and returns.
update: Think locally as well as nationally
Cement is heavy and transport costs matter. Regional demand, capacity and pricing can differ from the national picture.
company.question: Why can a cement company sell more tonnes but earn a lower margin?
company.answer: Selling prices may fall or energy, freight and material costs may rise faster than volume. More production does not guarantee more profit per tonne.
